scope: Loopback development identities and authenticated fixtures; no live WorkOS or hosted service acceptance.

checks: Anonymous players see only GitHub sign-in
Anonymous players cannot start either play mode
Signed-in pending players cannot start either play mode
Waitlist review opens with keyboard focus in its dialog
Approvers can review pending and decided accounts
User IDs are hidden from the waitlist by default
Approvers can reveal a user ID
Approvers can hide the user ID again
Approvers can copy a hidden user ID
Copying does not reveal the user ID
Approvers can revoke a prior approval with CSRF protection
Approvers can reconsider a declined request
Escape returns focus to the game controls

renderer: ANGLE (Apple, ANGLE Metal Renderer: Apple M3 Max, Unspecified Version)
